app.title: Ember
app.preview: Preview mode: your log is saved in this browser only.

load.failed: Couldn't read your saved log. Nothing will be written until it can be read.
load.unreadable: Your saved log is in a format this version can't read. It is kept as it is, and nothing will be written over it.

save.full: Your log is full (256 KB). That change was not kept.

setup.title: What do you use?
setup.hint: Pick one or more. You can change this later.

today.neverHint: Tap below when you have one.
today.label: today

reps.tap: Tap once per rep, or press the space bar

stretch.neckSub: Drop your chin, roll your head slowly from shoulder to shoulder.
stretch.shouldersSub: Lift your shoulders to your ears, roll them back and down.
stretch.reachSub: Hands together above your head, stretch as tall as you can.
stretch.foldSub: Stand, bend forward from the hips, let your arms hang.
stretch.chestSub: Hands behind your back, open your chest, look up a little.

walk.text: Get up and walk, anywhere. Come back when the circle closes.

water.text: Fill a glass and drink it slowly, sip by sip.

totals.title: Since {{date}}
totals.saved: of life kept by cravings passed
totals.source: Estimate: about 20 minutes of life per cigarette (UCL study, 2024). Counted for cigarettes only: no published figure exists for vapes or joints.

memory.title: Ask the chat about it
memory.offText: Ember can keep your log in Mnemosyne's memory, so the chat can answer "how am I doing?". It writes one summary per finished day and one current status, in Ember's own vault.
memory.walled: Your log is in the {{vault}} vault. The chat reads it once you unlock it: open the Vault panel, pick {{vault}}, and press "Unlock permanence".
memory.read: The chat can answer from your log.
memory.error: The last write did not land: {{reason}}
memory.forgetRefused: Your {{n}} entries are still in memory, the vault refused to forget them: {{reason}}
memory.forgottenUnknown: The vault forgot what Ember wrote.

patterns.title: Your patterns
patterns.peak: Most uses fall between {{from}} and {{to}}: {{n}} of {{total}}.
patterns.week: Weekdays: {{wd}} a day ({{wdDays}} days). Weekends: {{we}} a day ({{weDays}} days).
patterns.holdsTitle: Time until the next use, after a craving passed (median):
patterns.note: Links drawn from your own log, each with the count it rests on. They show when things happen, not why.

camera.title: Camera watch
camera.offText: Ember can notice when you smoke at your desk and ask you. It looks for a rhythm: a hand at your mouth several times in a few minutes. It needs the gesture camera on (Settings › Gestures).
camera.cameraOff: Watching, but the gesture camera is off. Turn it on in Settings › Gestures.
camera.watchingLast: Watching. Last hand at your mouth at {{time}} · {{n}} in the last 5 minutes.
camera.privacy: Ember receives only the time and length of each moment your hand stays at your mouth. The camera, your face and your hands stay inside Mnemosyne OS. Ember keeps nothing unless you answer yes.
camera.question: Smoking?
